title: Three Sisters Park

services.name: Disc Golf Course
services.desc: We try to post these events on our Facebook Page and our website often so that you know! It is free to play, but donations are always welcome, in order to continue to maintain and upgrade the quality of the course. The 18-hole disc golf course wraps through the wooded area near the center of the property and out to the southwest fields. Holes 5 and 12 will test your distance, measuring 480 yards, and 570 yards, respectively. Back into the woods, you’ll face obstacles such as trees and structures.
